findings.title: NetworkPolicy blocks the connection to a Service
findings.cause: container client exits because its connection to Service web times out: NetworkPolicy client-egress allows egress between them on port 80, the Service's port, but a policy is checked after the Service has forwarded the connection, against the pods' own port 8080 (the targetPort), which no rule allows; a blocked connection is dropped, not refused; its log says: "wget: download timed out"; Deployment client has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container client exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container client's log (current run)
evidence.detail:
Connecting to web (10.96.8.225:80)
wget: download timed out

evidence.what: NetworkPolicy client-egress allows egress on port 80, and no rule allows port 8080
evidence.command: kubectl get networkpolicy client-egress -n kd-networkpolicy-service-port -o jsonpath='{.spec.egress}'

evidence.what: Service web forwards port 80 to the pods' port 8080
evidence.command: kubectl get service web -n kd-networkpolicy-service-port -o jsonpath='{range .spec.ports[*]}{.port}{" -> "}{.targetPort}{"\n"}{end}'

findings.fix: In NetworkPolicy client-egress, allow port 8080, the pods' port, in place of 80: NetworkPolicy ports are the ports of pods, never of Services.
